body:
Verification-suite cost is now an explicit `verification_efficiency` entropy category. Review guidance considers safe parallelization, duplicated setup, and obsolete or superseded tests while requiring preservation of unique behavioral, platform, runtime, failure, integration, and regression evidence. Uncertain candidates become measurement work.

Initialization proposals include the category; existing reviewed policies retain their opt-ins. Suggestion and recent/full review cold-load the bounded contract, and ordinary execution records only already exposed facts.

Validation: 14 focused entropy tests, policy/default compatibility probe, prompt-budget checks, package/link inspection, and a bounded evidence-map review. Required cross-platform CI validates the exact PR head. No suite checks were removed or parallelized.

Tracks #379.
